title: P2P
supporting: Devices, remotes and nodes that reach this server over P2P, and the invites that let them in.
loadStatusFailed: Could not read the state of P2P.

off.title: P2P is off
off.reason: Set the P2P mode to Connect and share to invite devices, remotes and nodes. That mode needs authentication to be on.

connect.title: P2P is in Connect only mode
connect.reason: This server uses remotes over P2P and accepts nobody. To invite devices, set the mode to Connect and share. That mode needs authentication to be on.

device.title: Device
device.body: A launcher or another browser. The person signs in as today.

remote.title: Remote
remote.body: Another LocalAI uses all the models of this instance.

share.title: Share this instance
share.intro: Make a one-time invite link. The other side pastes it or scans its QR code.
share.qrNote: Device and remote invites show a QR code, for a phone or a tablet.

device.title: P2P admission only.
device.body: A device invite lets the device reach this instance. The person still signs in to the web UI with their own account.

remote.title: All models, nothing else.
remote.body: The other LocalAI gets an API key that can use every model of this instance, also the models you add later. Models with tools attached are left out. The key reaches nothing else: no settings, no files, no other part of the API.

share.label: Label
share.nothingYet: Nothing is made until you press Make invite.

needsAccount.title: Sign in with a user account to share with a remote
needsAccount.body: The other LocalAI gets an API key that belongs to your user account. You are signed in with the API key set with LOCALAI_API_KEY, which has no account. Sign in with a user account and make the invite again. Device invites work as before.

share.copyFailed: The link was not copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

result.title: Invite for {{label}}
result.qrLabel: QR code of the invite link
result.qrCaption: For a phone or a tablet

how.device: In the launcher: Add server, then Invite link. The link holds this server's peer ID and the relay pass, so a short code alone is not enough.
how.remote: On the other LocalAI: Home or Connections, Connect a remote, then Invite link. Paste the whole link.

result.waiting: Waiting for the device… Cancel invite also cancels its relay pass.
result.expiredBody: Nobody used it in time. Make a new one when the other side is ready.

admission.title: P2P admission only.
admission.result: The invite lets the device reach this instance. The person still signs in to the web UI.

unreachable.title: This invite has no relay pass. It can pair only over a direct connection.
unreachable.body: {{relay}} did not answer when the invite was made, so no pass is registered on it. Make the invite again when the relay is back.

noRelay.title: Devices behind strict NAT cannot connect without a relay.
noRelay.body: This server has no relay. About 3 in 10 networks block direct connections. Add a relay, or run one.

openRelay.title: This invite names an open relay.
openRelay.body: Anyone can use {{relay}}, and it may limit the speed of each connection.

noPublic.title: This server has no public address.
noPublic.body: The device connects by hole punching, or through a relay when that fails.

connected.title: {{label}} connected
connected.hint: {{label}} shows the same words now. If they do not match, someone else used the invite.
connected.signIn: The person still signs in to the web UI.
connected.keyNote: Revoke it any time in Devices and invites.

invites.title: Pending invites
invites.note: An invite works once and expires. Canceling an invite also cancels its relay pass.

empty.title: No pending invites
empty.body: Make an invite to let a device or a remote reach this server.

invites.passNone: None: pairs only over a direct connection

devices.title: Devices
devices.note: Each device has its own key. Revoke one and the others keep working.

empty.title: No paired devices yet
empty.body: A device appears here once it redeems an invite.

path.limitedHint: The relay limits the data or the time of each connection. Large transfers need a direct path.

revokeBody.device: The device loses its P2P key now and its open connections close. The person keeps their account. Other devices are not affected. To connect it again, make a new invite.
revokeBody.remote: The remote loses its P2P key and its API key now, and its open connections close. Its models stop working on the other side. Other devices are not affected. To connect it again, make a new invite.
revokeBody.other: The node loses its P2P key now and its open connections close. Other devices are not affected. To connect it again, make a new invite.

invite.linkHint: Ask the admin of the other LocalAI for a Remote invite and paste the whole link.

problem.malformed: This is not a LocalAI invite link. It starts with localai://pair.
problem.wrongKind: This is a {{kind}} invite. Ask the admin of the other LocalAI for a Remote invite.
problem.expired: This invite expired. Ask the admin of the other LocalAI for a new one.

preview.passNone: None: the link pairs over a direct connection or hole punching
preview.pathRelay: Direct first, then hole punching, then {{relay}}

invite.openRelay: The link names an open relay. Anyone can use it, and it may limit the speed of each connection.
invite.ok_one: Connected to {{name}} over P2P. Found {{count}} model.
invite.ok_other: Connected to {{name}} over P2P. Found {{count}} models.

switched.title: P2P is on in Connect only mode. This server accepts nobody.
switched.body: P2P was off. Connecting turned it on so this server can reach the other LocalAI. Change the mode under Swarm, P2P, Settings.

fail.title: Could not connect
fail.invalid: The invite is not valid: it was used, canceled or expired. Ask for a new one.
fail.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
fail.malformed: The other LocalAI could not read this invite.
fail.unsupported: This server cannot connect a remote with an invite link.
fail.conflict: This server is already paired with that LocalAI, or a remote of that name exists.

blocked.title: Both networks block direct connections.
blocked.body: Hole punching failed. About 3 in 10 pairs of networks need a relay that works.
blocked.bodyRelay: Hole punching failed, and {{relay}} did not answer. About 3 in 10 pairs of networks need a relay that works.
blocked.relayBody: The admin of the other LocalAI runs one on a machine with a public address, then sends a new invite.
blocked.portBody: Forward UDP and TCP 4001 to this server or to the other one.
blocked.networkBody: Put this server on another network, for example a phone hotspot, and try again.

home.title: Connect other machines
home.body: Use this server from your laptop, or add more machines. Needs authentication to be on.
home.openNote: There, set the P2P mode to Connect and share. You can do this later.
home.authNote: Authentication is off. To use another instance's models instead, pick On another server or service above: that needs no authentication.
